description: This file defines classes and functions for JSON-RPC message handling within the WPEFramework core, including message structure, error handling, context management, and method registration/execution.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC message with fields for version, id, method, parameters, result, and error information.

classes.name: Message::Info
classes.description: Encapsulates error information including code, message, and data.

classes.name: Message::Context
classes.description: Holds context information for JSON-RPC calls such as channel ID, sequence, and token.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Manages registration, invocation, and handling of JSON-RPC methods and notifications, supporting versioning and thread safety.

methods.name: Message::SetError
methods.description: Sets the error code and message based on a framework error code.

methods.name: Handler::Register
methods.description: Registers a method or callback for JSON-RPC invocation.

methods.name: Handler::Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a registered method with given parameters and context.
